groups.name: State and identity
groups.what: A halted service, a setpoint with no model behind it, or one for another battery is refused before any physics is checked.

groups.name: Sane numbers and time
groups.what: A NaN, a wrong type, or an interval that is not the current or the next one stops the checks; arithmetic on a NaN would pass silently.

groups.name: Fresh telemetry
groups.what: A state of charge older than one SCED interval, or outside the physical range, cannot be trusted to bound a setpoint.

groups.name: Power
groups.what: Net power within the battery's rating, awards that are real products, and discharge plus up awards (or charge plus down awards) within the rating.

groups.name: Energy to deliver
groups.what: The projected end-of-interval charge stays inside its bounds, and holds enough energy for every award it sold, and room to absorb a down award.

groups.name: Exposure
groups.what: The cost basis of the energy in the battery after the trade may not exceed the cap. The least settled limit: a business decision.

groups.name: The guard itself
groups.what: Any exception inside the guard is a rejection, never a pass.

failPaths.name: Forecast failed

failPaths.name: LP not optimal

failPaths.name: Guard rejects
failPaths.what: Any one reason code of the guard: the setpoint is not edited, it is dropped.

failPaths.name: Audit or ledger refuses
failPaths.what: No audit record means no execution; the ledger re-checks the limits itself.
